verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Public REST API, OAuth and personal tokens, a raw OpenAPI spec, and an MCP server, but never mentions any official SDK or client library. An OpenAPI spec is a building block a developer could use to generate a client, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here. Publishing official SDKs is a fair question for a SaaS platform, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
